# Zillow

> > Zillow is a leading real estate marketplace platform offering property search, home valuations, rental listings, mortgage services, and marketing tools for real estate professionals.

Zillow operates a comprehensive real estate ecosystem including consumer-facing search tools for buyers and renters, the Zillow Premier Agent platform for real estate professionals, and complementary brands like Trulia, StreetEasy, and Hotpads. The platform provides home value estimates (Zestimates), mortgage calculators, and lead generation services for agents.

## Key Topics

- Zillow
- Zillow Premier Agent
- Zillow Group
- Property listings and search
- Rental search and apartments
- Home values and Zestimates
- Mortgage services and calculators
- Real estate agent marketing
- Lead generation for agents
- Trulia
- StreetEasy
- Hotpads
- Zillow Flex
- Buyer-agent connections
- Real estate advertising

## Core Platform

- [Zillow: Real Estate, Apartments, Mortgages & Home Values](https://www.zillow.com/): Zillow homepage for searching property listings, rentals, and home values

## Real Estate Professional Tools

- [Zillow Premier Agent](https://premieragent.zillow.com/): Zillow Premier Agent platform connecting real estate agents with buyers
